description: Search DataWorth AI's directory of companies and programs that license a business's operating records (email, chat, files, CRM, code, CAD) to AI developers. Facts come from each company's own site; payouts are quoted in its own words and are not offers. Results are alphabetical (or by text relevance when a query is given), never by referral fee. Use this to list or compare buyers; to compare one company's facts with programs' eligibility rules, use check_fit.

accepts_closed.description: true = only buyers whose pages say they take winding-down or closed companies.

data_type.description: Kind of records the buyer says it licenses.

detail.description: full (default) = every field with quotes and sources; summary = id, name, type, where, size rule and page only (smaller response; use get_buyer for one entry's full detail).

industry.description: Only buyers whose own pages name this industry. Many buyers take records from any industry; omit to see them.

region.description: outside_US = buyers whose pages say they take or estimate for non-US companies.

name: search_buyers
title: Search AI data buyers
